official.name: Spanish
official.note: Rioplatense dialect — voseo and "sh"-like ll/y pronunciation, shared with Argentina

terrainDescription.zh: 地形以平緩丘陵與農牧平原為主，全國幾乎沒有高山，大西洋與拉布拉他河沿岸海岸線平直。
terrainDescription.en: Mostly gentle rolling hills and agricultural/ranching plains, with almost no real mountains anywhere and a fairly straight Atlantic/Río de la Plata coastline.

plate.color: white background, black text/frame; blue Mercosur band at top (mandatory since 2016)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Distinctive white-fronted bollard with a rectangular reflector near the top

utilityPole.transformerMount: Thick white wooden sign posts are common; utility poles often have a "trident" shape with three upward-facing bulbs at the top

historicalContext.zh: 烏拉圭道路中線常見獨特的「三線」設計——雙黃實線中間夾雜白色虛線，這種組合在美洲其他地方少見；西班牙語為官方語言，方言與阿根廷同屬拉布拉他河口方言。
historicalContext.en: Uruguayan roads often feature a distinctive triple-line pattern — double solid yellow lines with white dashes running between them — a combination rarely seen elsewhere in the Americas. Spanish is official, sharing the Rioplatense dialect with neighboring Argentina.
